title: Pangolin Prime
extract:
The Pangolin Prime is the primed variant of the  Pangolin Sword, acting as a direct upgrade. It was released alongside  Titania Prime and  Corinth Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Slam Radial Damage deals  Impact damage.
Slam Radial Damage has a guaranteed  Slash proc in addition to the  Impact proc.
Stance slot has  polarity, matches  Crimson Dervish,  Vengeful Revenant and  Swooping Falcon.
Innate two  polarities.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Second highest base damage of all swords, behind  Dark Sword.

Acquisition

Vaultings
On March 28th, 2022, Pangolin Prime, along with  Titania Prime and  Corinth Prime, entered the Prime Vault and were retired from the reward tables. Any preexisting components or fully-built items will remain as is.

Notes
Guaranteed  Slash proc on slam radial damage.
Slam radial damage and proc damage is affected by  Seismic Wave, base damage mods (e.g.  Pressure Point) and faction mods (e.g.  Smite Grineer).
Does not affect heavy slam attacks.

Trivia
The sword is likely named after the Pangolin, a mammal found in Asia and Africa whose protective scales resemble the blade's scaly texture.
This weapon originally lacked the unique Slam Attack properties of the predecessor, instead procing only  Impact status. This was changed in Update 35.0.7.

Bugs
Despite the patch notes claiming the damage type of the slam was changed to  Puncture, it still deals pure  Impact damage as of Hotfix 42.0.11 (2026-05-14).
